purpose: A lab management module within the UNILIS learning management system for managing student practicals, lab sessions, experiments, report submissions, IoT device integration (RFID/CO2), QR-based authentication, blockchain-based audit trails, and complete lab asset/inventory management.

architecture.pattern: Front Controller MVC (custom PHP, no framework)
request_lifecycle: 1. Apache mod_rewrite in .htaccess: All non-file/non-directory requests rewritten to index.php?url=<path>

2. index.php: Loads environment config (app.php or app_production.php), database config, roles config, and helper utilities. Checks session authentication. If unauthenticated and not accessing auth/qr routes, redirects to landing.html.

3. routes/web.php: Parses URL segments into controller name, method, and optional parameter. Maps controller name (e.g., 'practicals') to controller class (e.g., 'PracticalController') using a hardcoded associative array. Instantiates the controller and calls the method with the parameter.
4. Controller: Loads models via require_once, performs business logic, renders views using renderView() helper.
5. Model: PDO-based database queries using a singleton getDB() function.
6. View: Procedural PHP templates rendered via renderView() which includes layouts/header.php, the template, and layouts/footer.php.
architecture.environment_detection: index.php checks if $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] contains 'unilis.jhubafrica.com' to determine production vs development mode and loads corresponding config files.

directory_structure.views/: Subdirectories per feature (practicals, auth, dashboard, student, reports, etc.) with layouts/ for header and footer
directory_structure.config/: app.php, database.php, roles.php, and their _production counterparts
directory_structure.auth/: Auth.php - authentication class with multiple auth methods
directory_structure.utils/: helpers.php (renderView, sanitize, logActivity, etc.), Validator.php, Mailer.php
directory_structure.migrations/: SQL migration files for database schema changes
directory_structure.blockchain/: Block.php, Blockchain.php, AssetTracker.php - custom blockchain implementation
directory_structure.web-app/: Python-based sensor server for CO2 monitoring (smart-lab-server.py), data-api.php

auth_methods.description: Login via reg_number + password (password_verify with bcrypt)
Login via pre-registered biometric hash (SHA-256 with BIOMETRIC_SALT)
Login via QR token that encodes sessionId + timestamp, verified with HMAC-SHA256 using QR_SECRET_KEY (5 min expiry)
Login via RFID UID, looked up in rfid_cards table linked to users
Login via technician-generated confirmation code linked to lab_sessions (8-hour validity)

security_features: Session timeout check (SESSION_LIFETIME, default 3600s) with last_activity tracking
Multi-factor authentication support (initiateMultiFactor, verifyMultiFactor) for admin/lecturer roles
QR token HMAC signing with 5-minute expiry

user_roles.student: Can view and take practicals, submit reports, view grades
user_roles.lecturer: Can create/edit/manage practicals, grade reports, view analytics
user_roles.technician: Can manage labs, generate auth codes, assist with experiments
user_roles.admin: Full system management, user management, lab configuration

methods.index: Renders dashboard with stats, lab occupancy, today's schedule, activity, blockchain blocks, weekly activity, lab utilization, asset breakdown, top users, practical completion rates, system health
Lists all practicals with access windows, stats, and student report mapping
methods.create: Creates practical with UUID ID, validates date/time, checks lab availability (max 3/day, time slot conflicts), supports rich content (TinyMCE)
methods.edit: Updates practical, checks lab availability excluding current ID
methods.view: Shows practical detail with enrolled students and lab sessions
methods.checkAvailability: AJAX endpoint for real-time lab availability checking
methods.startPractical: AJAX endpoint to start a practical session (checks attendance, creates report)
methods.markAttendance: AJAX endpoint to mark attendance (QR, RFID, or fingerprint verification)

steps: 1. Lecturer/Admin creates practical: Sets title, objective, theory, description, lab, course code, date/time, max students, equipment, chemicals, procedure (JSON), observations table, safety notes, results/calculations templates
2. Publish practical: Status changes from 'draft' to 'published'
3. Lab availability check: Max 3 practicals per lab per day, time slot conflict prevention
4. Attendance marking: Students mark attendance via QR code, RFID, or fingerprint within a 30-min-before to 20-min-after window
5. Access window: Students can access practical starting 30 minutes before scheduled time until 20 minutes after start time
6. Start practical: Creates a lab report with 'in_progress' status
7. Student executes practical: Tabbed interface with aims, materials, procedure, data tables, calculations, results, conclusion sections - auto-save enabled
8. Submit report: Final submission of lab report (draft → final pipeline)
9. Grading: Lecturer grades the report, adds marks and feedback
10. Blockchain audit: All activities logged to blockchain for tamper-proof audit trail

rfid.description: RFID card registration and login system
rfid.implementation: rfid_cards table links UID hex strings to user accounts. One card per student (upsert logic). Auth::loginByRFID() and Auth::registerRFIDCard() handle the flow.

qr_code.description: QR code generation and verification for lab session authentication
qr_code.implementation: Auth::generateQR() creates HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens with session ID and timestamp. Auth::verifyQR() validates signature and expiry (5 min). QRCodeGenerator.php class provides rendering.

co2_sensor.description: CO2 monitoring via Python WebSocket server (smart-lab-server.py)
co2_sensor.implementation: Python WebSocket server running on configurable host:port. SensorServerClient.php communicates with it. JSON data stored in web-app/co2_data/. SmartLab dashboard includes CO2 monitor widget (components/co2_monitor_widget.php).

blockchain_subsystem.description: Custom PHP blockchain implementation for immutable audit logging of lab activities, asset transfers, and report submissions

structure.AssetTracker: Tracks asset transfers and ownership changes on the blockchain

datasheet_system.description: Chemical safety datasheet management with PDF generation
datasheet_system.workflow: Technicians upload chemical datasheets → stored in database → searchable/printable → PDF generation for download

digital_signature.purpose: Digital signing of lab reports and documents for verification and non-repudiation

key_functions: redirect(path) - HTTP redirect with APP_URL prefix
renderView(template, data) - Renders PHP view with header/footer layout, extracts data array
sanitizeHTML(html) - Safe HTML cleaning using DOMDocument, allows specific tags (p, br, strong, table, etc.) and attributes, removes scripts, event handlers, javascript: protocol
jsonResponse(data, code) - JSON response with status code
generateSignature(techId, docId) - SHA-256 signature for document verification
logActivity(userId, action, module) - Inserts audit log entry
getPracticalAccessWindow(practical, now) - Calculates access window for practicals: available 30 min before to 20 min after start time
